title: Amazon, once an online bookseller, is destroying rare books to train AI models
summary: Amazon is buying tons of rare books, cutting off their spines, and scanning them for AI training, according to 404 Media , which placed a tracking device in a rare book that ultimately arrived at an Amazon facility in Las Vegas.
